chunks: "The beginning of al-'Aqiq is Barid al-Ba'th, and it is a postal stage before Barid Ghamrah."

key_terms.الْبَعْثِ: al-Ba'th, the specific station named as the beginning
key_terms.الْعَقِيقِ: al-'Aqiq, the designated location being discussed
key_terms.بَرِيدُ: a postal stage or measured station on the route
key_terms.غَمْرَةَ: Ghamrah, another station used here as a geographic reference

ai.seo_question: Where does al-'Aqiq begin for the purpose of entering ihram?
ai.summary: This hadith identifies the starting point of al-'Aqiq as Barid al-Ba'th, locating it before Barid Ghamrah. In the chapter on the appointed times for entering ihram, it serves as a geographical-legal clarification relevant to hajj rites.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2525 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"The beginning of Al-‘Aqiq is Barid al-Ba‘th, which is a station before Barid Ghamrah."
